bias.en: Bearish · collapsed below the 200-day, April gap filled
bias.zh: 看空 · 暴跌跌破 200 日均线，4月缺口已回补

read.en: Intel plunged 28.6% on Oct 30 to $65.76, trading between $63.20 and $68.77 on 4.6 times average volume, after a 3.6% drop on Oct 29. It is below the falling 5-day ($87.5), 10-day ($88.7), 30-day ($104.6) and 100-day ($104.8) averages and the rising 200-day ($86.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 30 ($95.68), and RSI is 25.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月30日暴跌 28.6%，收于 $65.76，盘中区间 $63.20–68.77，成交量为均量的 4.6 倍；此前 10月29日下跌 3.6%。股价位于下行的 5 日（$87.5）、10 日（$88.7）、30 日（$104.6）和 100 日均线（$104.8）以及上行的 200 日均线（$86.9）下方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 10月30日转为看空（$95.68），RSI 为 25。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $93–95.4, $90.4–91.4 and the 200-day, and filled the April gap ($68.3–79.6). Resistance is $68.3–68.8 (Apr 23 and Oct 30 highs), then $79.6 (Apr 24 low) and $84.7–86.9 (Oct 22 low, 200-day). Support is $63.2–65 (Oct 30 low, Apr 20–22 lows), then $62.1 and $58.4 (Apr 9 low). A close above $68.8 would target $79.6; below $63.2, $62.

r.en: Apr 24 low, top of the April gap

s.en: Oct 30 low $63.2; Apr 20 and Apr 22 lows ($64.5–65.0)
